```python
def test_cycpattern_check():
    # Exact pattern
    assert cycpattern_check("xxabcxx", "abc") is True

    # Cyclic rotations of "abc": "bca" and "cab"
    assert cycpattern_check("xxbcaxx", "abc") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("xxcabxx", "abc") is True

    # No matching cyclic pattern
    assert cycpattern_check("xxacbxx", "abc") is False

    # Pattern longer than the searched string
    assert cycpattern_check("ab", "abc") is False

    # Match at string boundaries
    assert cycpattern_check("cabxyz", "abc") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("xyabca", "abc") is True

    # Single-character pattern
    assert cycpattern_check("hello", "e") is True
    assert cycpattern_check("hello", "z") is False
```
